_comment: EXAMPLE fixture only (issue #1073). Used exclusively to unit-test the snapshot-evaluation logic in low_end_device_performance.test.ts. The benchmark gate itself NEVER reads this file - it requires a snapshot really measured by a headless Godot run (scripts/run-headless-performance-benchmark.sh writes it to generated/headless_benchmark.snapshot.json). Device telemetry captures may be dropped into generated/ using this same schema.
